name: player_record_recent_hit_feedback
description: Player::RecordRecentHitFeedback stores recent-hit source, damage, owner/context, timeout, and restarts the recent-hit effect on the player root node.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a Player combat/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43b730 validates writing recentHitValid, owner/context from HitContext::GetCurrentOwnerOrCtx, hit source, damage, timeout as g_Time_AccumulatedTimeSec + 4.0f, stopping an existing effect handle, and storing the SetPositionRefAndVelocity_Thunk result for g_PlayerRecentHitFxAnimEntry bound to the player root node.
The native smoke verifies state writes, owner/context propagation, old effect stop dispatch, timeout, and replacement effect activation.
